title: Leaver accounts still active
condition: 4 leaver accounts active, one with billing admin rights.
recommendation: Disable at once; same-day leaver step in the access policy.

title: ICT support firm admin accounts without MFA
condition: 2 generic admin accounts with no multi-factor authentication.
recommendation: Named admin accounts with MFA; remove generic accounts.

title: Shared logins and excess rights
condition: Shared reception logins in FairwayOne and the chatbot console; cashier refund rights; guard export rights.
recommendation: Named accounts for reception; remove excess rights.

title: No supplier alerting or out-of-hours contact
condition: FairwayOne gave no alert on a large export and had no weekend contact.
recommendation: Agree export alerts and an out-of-hours line; add to the contract and contact list.

title: Recovery point objective not met
condition: Nightly backups mean up to 24 hours of bookings and billing could be lost; target is 1 to 4 hours.
recommendation: Ask FairwayOne for more frequent backups or accept the risk formally.

title: Fuel store and staff car park not covered
condition: No camera on the fuel tank; poor lighting at the store and the far car park.

title: Key register incomplete
condition: 24 of 180 keys unaccounted for, including cash office keys.
recommendation: Complete the register; rekey the cash office.

title: Staff fall for phishing
condition: 9 of 40 staff clicked and 4 entered a password in the simulation.
recommendation: Awareness training for all office staff; repeat the simulation in 6 months.

title: No member fraud warning template
condition: The member warning was delayed to 52 hours in the exercise.
recommendation: Pre-approve a warning; DPO can send it within 24 hours.

title: No spare CCTV recorder
condition: Cameras were off for 9 hours in the recovery test.
recommendation: Buy a spare recorder or back up key cameras to the cloud.
